items.q: Is weed delivery legal in Bowie, MD?

blocks.html: Yes. Since the legalization of adult-use cannabis in Maryland, licensed delivery services can legally bring cannabis products to private residences in Bowie.
For recreational users, the daily limit is 1.5 ounces of flower, 12 grams of concentrated cannabis (including vapes), or edible products containing up to 750mg of THC.

items.q: How long does delivery usually take?

blocks.html: We strive for industry-leading delivery times. While traffic and order volume can affect the schedule, most Bowie deliveries are completed within 60 to 90 minutes.

items.q: Do you deliver to public places?

blocks.html: No. State regulations require that all cannabis deliveries be made to a private residential address. We cannot deliver to parks, government buildings, or public spaces.
